# Cartographic Brief: The Known Galaxy

**Date:** 2026-10-29
**Phase:** 0 of the [atlas map plan](../../docs/ATLAS_MAP_PLAN_2026_10_29.md)
**Sketch:** [`layout_sketch_v0.svg`](layout_sketch_v0.svg), generated by
`node design/map/make_sketch.js design/map/layout_sketch_v0.svg`

This brief records the author's map decisions and turns them into placement
rules for Phase 1. Its register of spatial claims (section 4) is what the
placement file, `design/map/cartography.yaml`, and its lint will encode.

## 1. Authority

- On 2026-10-29 the author accepted all ten recommendations in section 9 of
  the plan. Section 2 restates them as decisions.
- Under decision 1, claims marked **Approved** in section 4 are working
  canon. They are topology: containment, adjacency, and radial order.
  Claims marked **Proposed** are this brief's own derivations and still need
  the author's approval.
- All geometry is cartographic interpretation, *P.A.* (position
  approximate). That covers every radius, angle, size, and shape in section 3
  and in the sketch.
- Primary canon outranks this brief. If a later primary-canon story
  contradicts an approved claim, the story stands and the claim is revised.
- A claim about a speculative entity governs the author build only. It binds
  canon when that entity is approved.
- No entity's `canon_tier` or `metadata.status` changes because of this
  brief.

## 2. Decisions

| # | Decision |
|---|----------|
| D1 | Topology is working canon. Geometry stays cartographic and carries *P.A.* notes. The map never becomes primary canon on its own authority. |
| D2 | **Shape:** a spiral disk whose arms carry the density gradient. **Layout:** the Core at the center; the Drift as a galactic belt whose outer sleeve is a sparse deep-orbit ring around the Core; the Lattice Gap as a rift at the Lattice's outer reach, with its outer sleeve touching a Void Region; the Remnant Seas as pockets beyond the Drift; Voids scattered, densest at the margins; the Black Horizon as the perimeter, its interior uncharted. |
| D3 | A 2D chart is the canonical artifact. An optional 2.5D gravity-well view may follow. No z-coordinates. |
| D4 | Heavonly sits at the Drift–Core boundary, in the author build only. No other galaxies are drawn until the novel settles the count. |
| D5 | **Sleeve:** a band of any region, named relative to the region's inward edge. The Drift's outer sleeve holds nine numbered sleeves, counted outward. **Pull:** a count of drive engagements, never converted to distance or time. Both are lexicon `draft` terms. |
| D6 | Placements as listed in section 4: Solace at the Gap–Void contact, Ostra-Vael on a Seas boundary, black-hole knots, Ebbhaven *E.D.*, Halix on a circuit, the Vault at the outer sleeve's inner edge. "The Tides" is not a mapped region. |
| D7 | **Two builds.** The author build shows every tier, with speculative entities faded. The public build includes only primary and working canon, and excludes draft data at build time. Halix and Skather-Ait get a source-first review against `story-0004`. |
| D8 | The author build is private, on the VPS behind basic auth. The public build launches with a reader-facing occasion. Public panels carry summaries only. |
| D9 | Procedural art first. Judge a style frame after Phase 2. A commissioned hero map, if wanted, is work made for hire with an assignment backstop. No AI plates. |
| D10 | A placement is required at promotion (playbook Step 6b), not at drafting. Drafting agents may propose a placement in the PR body but do not edit the placement file. After the Phase 1 backfill, CI errors on an unplaced primary-canon location and warns on a speculative one. A placement change is a Canon Impact line. |

## 3. Chart Frame (geometry, all *P.A.*)

Coordinates are unitless polar values. *r* is the chart radius, with 1.0 at
the Black Horizon's near edge. *θ* is degrees counterclockwise from the
chart's right-hand side. No distance is implied.

| Zone | *r* |
|------|-----|
| Mnemosyne Lattice Core | 0 – 0.12 |
| Core margin, where Heavonly sits | 0.12 – 0.18 |
| Helios Drift: inner relay | 0.18 – 0.30 |
| Helios Drift: mid-sleeve | 0.30 – 0.46 |
| Helios Drift: outer sleeve, numbered sleeves I–IX of equal width, counted outward | 0.46 – 0.62 |
| Beyond the Drift: Gap, Seas, Voids | 0.62 – 1.00 |
| Black Horizon; far edge uncharted | 1.00 – 1.20+ |

| Feature | *r* | *θ* |
|---------|-----|-----|
| Heavonly (speculative) | 0.165 | 100 |
| Navigant house, inner relay | 0.225 | 338 |
| Tessarine Vault | 0.46 | 338 |
| Halix Exchange circuit, center (speculative) | 0.545 | 302 |
| Skather-Ait pod (speculative) | 0.60 | 294 |
| Lattice Gap rift: inner tip to outer edge | 0.62 → 0.93 | 35 → 43; half-width 1.2° → 9.7° |
| Gap near sleeve / outer sleeve | 0.62–0.72 / 0.84–0.93 | within the rift |
| Heliodrome | 0.76 | 38.6 |
| Solace Hospice (speculative) | 0.90 | 50.7, on the rift's edge |
| Void touching the Gap's outer sleeve | 0.955 | 56 |
| Other Voids | 0.665, 0.67, 0.66, 0.885, 0.90, 0.80 | 112, 248, 322, 128, 272, 345 |
| Remnant Seas pockets | 0.81, 0.86, 0.78 | 165, 221, 292 |
| Ostra-Vael (speculative) | 0.725 | 160, on the Drift-facing boundary |
| Narthex of Low Mercy (speculative) | 1.09 | 78 |
| Ebbhaven buoy, *E.D.* (speculative) | 0.965 | 140 |

The *Archivist's Wake* route is drawn into the Heliodrome with its canon
count of three pulls. Its start point is *P.A.* The Vault-to-relay leg
carries its canon count of two pulls.

## 5. Open Questions

1. **T26–T29** need approval, or a correction.
2. **Fourth Sleeve population.** Canon gives none. The sketch leaves it
   blank and does not infer it from the ordering.
3. **Unnamed sleeves.** Sleeves I, III, VI, and VIII are implied by the nine
   housings but never named. The sketch shows them without figures.
4. **The unnamed Black Horizon station** from `ss/the_mercy_doctrine` is
   story-local by its own continuity note. It is not placed.
5. **Story-local and draft sites** have no placement yet: Tern Gate Station,
   Waystation 11-C, the High Archives, the Lattice Gap moon colony, and the
   Synod abandoned station. Each waits for its source story's promotion
   (D10).

## 6. Density Consistency

Phase 1's lint will check the rendered field against these soundings. The
sketch already satisfies the ordering. Region values fall strictly with
radius:

> Core 0.97 > Drift 0.65 > Gap 0.31 > Seas 0.04 > Horizon 0.01

The Voids are holes at 0.00. Sites may peak above their surroundings.

| Sounding | Value | Sketch *r* | Note |
|----------|-------|------------|------|
| Mnemosyne Lattice Core | 0.97 | 0–0.12 | |
| Heavonly | 0.82 | 0.165 | Speculative; lies between Core and Drift, as D4 intends |
| Tessarine Vault | 0.78 | 0.46 | Site peak above the Drift band; pre-breach, unmeasured after |
| Helios Drift | 0.65 | 0.18–0.62 | Region value; pre-breach |
| Halix Exchange | 0.56 | 0.545 | Speculative; below the Drift value, as the thinning outer sleeve implies |
| Lattice Gap, Heliodrome | 0.31 | 0.62–0.93, 0.76 | |
| Ostra-Vael | 0.30 | 0.725 | Speculative site peak on the Seas boundary; to be verified separately from the story's 30% integrity (`docs/governance/provisional_profiles.md`) |
| Remnant Seas | 0.04 | pockets, 0.70–0.95 | |
| Narthex of Low Mercy | 0.015 | 1.09 | Speculative; a site held deliberately light, still above the Horizon value |
| Black Horizon | 0.01 | 1.00–1.20 | |
| Void Regions | 0.00 | holes | Nothing drawn inside |
